body:
### Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.

LlmRequest.model_dump() serializes every Gemini config field even when null, adding 4–8KB of nulls per payload. In workflows with many LLM calls, this bloats activity inputs unnecessarily without adding any information.

### Describe the solution you'd like

Null fields could be stripped before passing the request to the activity — model_dump(exclude_none=True) or equivalent. This could be the default behavior or opt-in via a config flag.

### Additional context

This feedback is based on the Python SDK's ADK integration, but the same pattern applies to other SDK implementations of TemporalModel. We strip nulls in our subclass before passing to the activity. No semantic change — nulls carry no information in this context.

Adding this too: This pattern was identified while working on the ADK/Temporal NEXT demo: https://github.com/temporal-community/ice-cream-fleet-demo

Tracking: AI-61 (https://temporalio.atlassian.net/browse/AI-61)
title: [Feature Request] Strip null fields from LlmRequest serialization in TemporalModel
